contexts.text: The speech of the intermediate Spirits is sweet...
See Sweet.
The predominance of good is represented in the flavour and sweetness which are perceived in ripe grapes.
The reason honey = delight, is that it is sweet; for everything sweet in the natural world corresponds to delight and pleasantness in the Spiritual World.
It has been granted me to perceive, by influx, the sweetness of the Angels, which they perceive from this: that they do not think and will from themselves... SE 2870.
The waters were made sweet () = that thus truths were made delightful. Sweet = delight; for sweet, in the spiritual sense, is the sweet of life, which is one with delight.
At last he feels nothing sweeter (than the delight of evil).
To be in the mouth sweet as honey () = that the first of reception is grateful and delightful. AE 619.
Conjugial love (then) inspires into them the sweetnesses of love...
Entreating them... for this sweet addition to their life.
A sweet and vinous odour comes from those who from a kind of lawful love flatter those whom they love...
On the sweet speech of celestial Spirits.
The sweetness of the flux came from the fact that they were good...
As there is true goodness in them... there is also true sweetness.
They who begin to indulge in idleness find in it the greatest sweetness...
Spirits who have as an end that their life may be sweet; thus simulate friendships for the sake of sweet intercourse... Such are there given to magical arts.
They feel a sweetness (in Gehenna).
Meanwhile I was in a sweet sleep.
He had put on the persuasion that in the other life he would have a sweet sleep.
A sweet undulation over my head (from lascivious girls).
He wanted to insinuate himself by such things as were sweet to them.
They who (here) appear good and sweet in face... but inwardly think evilly of all.
Sweet = what is delightful from the good of truth and the truth of good. AE 619:14, Illustrated. AE 621.
The sweetness of the delight of the love of exercising command is ineffable.
